page.overview:
What is That Was Just Your Life?

That Was Just Your Life is the opening track to Metallica's ninth studio album, Death Magnetic.

It centers on themes of PTSD, addiction and the feeling of watching one's life pass by due to internal struggles. The lyrics portray an "endless fight," where personal demons, trauma, or addiction create a repetitive, nightmarish existence.

Like a siren in my head that always Threatens to repeat Like a blind man that is strapped into the speeding driver's seat Like a face That learns to speak When all it knew was how to bite

Like a misery that keeps me focused Though I've gone astray Like an endless nightmare that I must awaken from each day Like conviction A premonition Not worthy of, so I deny...... I deny
